translations.web: How beautiful and how pleasant you are, love, for delights!
translations.bsb: How fair and pleasant you are, O love, with your delights!
translations.kjv: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
translations.asv: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
